d:
Tony Beets has a massive plan: bring an old gold dredge back to life and turn it into a gold-producing machine. But resurrecting this giant is no easy task. From transporting heavy equipment and tackling mechanical setbacks to getting the dredge operational, Tony faces one challenge after another. With time, money and a fortune in gold at stake, can he make his ambitious dredge project pay off?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 6, Episodes 16, 2, 19, 5, 9, 11, 13, 18 and 12, on Discovery Channel India.
